nodes.meaning: Exact cardinality of a finite set of distinct nonnegative integer identities.
Immediate finite-natural successor n+1, within the declared teaching bound.
Exact nonnegative integer quotient; divisor must be positive and divide the dividend.
Begin a literal finite Number set; existing syntax.end closes it. Duplicate members are invalid.
Begin disjoint equal-sized finite Number sets; each set and the group list close with syntax.end. Context witnesses multiplication or exact division.
